name: Command Palette UI
description: Ctrl+P fuzzy file finder overlay. Shows search input, progress bar during initial file walk, filtered results with file name and directory path, and recent files section when input is empty.

dom.root: .palette-overlay (position: fixed, inset: 0, background: var(--scrim), display: none → flex when .open class added, z-index: 9999, role=dialog, aria-modal=true, justify-content: center, padding-top: 15vh)

elements.palette: .palette (width: 560px, max-height: 420px, background: var(--surface), border: 1px dashed var(--border), border-radius: 8px, box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), display: flex, flex-direction: column, overflow: hidden)
elements.palette-input: input.palette-input (width: 100%, padding: 14px 18px, background: transparent, border: none, border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border), outline: none, color: var(--primary), font: 14px 'Space Mono', 'Courier New', monospace, placeholder: 'Search files by name...', aria-label/autocomplete/spellcheck set, autofocus on open)
elements.palette-item: .palette-item (display: flex, gap: 8px, padding: 8px 16px, cursor: pointer, align-items: baseline; &.is-selected: background var(--accent), color white)
elements.palette-item-dir: .palette-item-dir (font-size: 11px, color: var(--tertiary), overflow: hidden, text-overflow: ellipsis, white-space: nowrap)
elements.palette-section-header: .palette-section-header (padding: 8px 16px 4px, font-size: 9px, font-weight: 700, letter-spacing: 1px, color: var(--tertiary), text: 'RECENT FILES')

interactions.name: search
interactions.action: Clear searchTimer → If empty: show recent files → If non-empty: set 150ms timeout → On timeout: if files not yet loaded, show progress bar and start recursive dir walk via fs:readDir (skip .git, node_modules, .cockpit) → Filter results by substring match on name and path (case-insensitive) → Limit 50 → Render results
interactions.timing: throttled 150ms debounce, initial index walk is async
interactions.result: Results list renders matching files with name + relative directory

interactions.name: navigate_down
interactions.action: Move .is-selected class to next .palette-item → scrollIntoView block:nearest

interactions.name: navigate_up
interactions.action: Move .is-selected class to previous .palette-item → scrollIntoView block:nearest

interactions.name: mouse_hover
interactions.action: Find index of item in parent → Update selectedIndex → Update .is-selected across all sibling items
interactions.result: Hovered item highlighted, keyboard selection synced

interactions.name: select
interactions.trigger: Enter keydown on .palette-input OR mousedown on .palette-item
interactions.action: confirmSelection(): if input empty and recent files exist, select recent index; otherwise select results[selectedIndex] → selectFile adds to recent localStorage → close → onSelectFile callback
interactions.result: File opened in editor, palette hidden, recent cache updated

interactions.name: close
interactions.trigger: Escape keydown OR click on .palette-overlay (target === overlay)

states.idle: Overlay with .open class, input focused after 50ms setTimeout, results show recent files section or 'No recent files' message
states.indexing: .palette-progress visible, input disabled for typing, results show 'Searching files...'
states.results: Filtered results displayed, keyboard+mouse navigation active, selectedIndex tracks current item
states.empty: No files match query — 'No matching files' message shown in .palette-empty
states.closed: Overlay without .open class (display:none via CSS), timers cleared
